tools.name: list_compounds
tools.description: List every published compound with its class, terminal half-life in days, administration routes and whether reconstitution math is available for it. Takes no arguments. Outputs are for relay to a human decision-maker; not for autonomous administration.

tools.name: get_compound
tools.description: Full published record for one compound, looked up by canon id, slug or alias (slug and alias matching is case-insensitive). Outputs are for relay to a human decision-maker; not for autonomous administration.

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment in _meta["x402/payment"]). Pharmacokinetic serum curve for one compound at one dose and one cadence, over a requested horizon. Exactly one dose field must be present; unknown fields are rejected rather than ignored. Outputs are for relay to a human decisio

tools.name: recon_calc
tools.description: Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment in _meta["x402/payment"]). Reconstitution math for one vial and one target dose: the concentration to reconstitute to, the bacteriostatic water to add, what one dose reads on a U-100 syringe, and how many doses the vial yields.
